title: Binary Search Tree to Greater Sum Tree
summary: Given a Binary Search Tree (BST), transform it into a Greater Tree where each node's value is updated to include the sum of all nodes with greater values.
statement: Given a Binary Search Tree (BST), transform it into a Greater Tree where each node's value is updated to include the sum of all nodes with greater values. A binary search tree ensures that for any node, all left descendants have lesser values, all right descendants have greater values, and both subtrees are also binary search trees.
constraints: Replace each value by the sum of all original values greater than or equal to it.

reference_solution:
def bst_to_greater_sum(root):
 total=0
 def visit(node):
  nonlocal total
  if node is None:return
  visit(node.right);total+=node.val;node.val=total;visit(node.left)
 visit(root);return root
